scientific_integrity: All mathematical assertions derive from the recurrence proof; finite tests are distinguished from infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: The proof applies to integer-valued symmetric recurrences of order r in {2,3} and odd primes not dividing c. It does not settle prime-power lifting, prime-density questions or generic cubic perturbations. The previously established Apéry and selected quadratic cases are not claimed as new; historical priority remains qualified.
title: A twisted prime-index reciprocity theorem for integral Apéry-like recurrences
